title: Launch PCSX2 directly into Big Picture mode
summary: Use the official `-bigpicture` option when building a controller-only PCSX2 launch shortcut, and verify the interface separately from game boot.
heroAlt: A black DualShock 2 controller on a light background.
author: EmuCore - Hub
searchKeywords: launch pcsx2 big picture for controller only play
Launch PCSX2 directly into Big Picture mode

blocks.text: PCSX2 documents `-bigpicture` as forcing its Big Picture mode, useful for controller-only and couch play. You can combine it with `-fullscreen` if you want that interface to open full-screen. The switch changes the PCSX2 interface at launch; it does not pair a controller, map buttons, launch a game, or change game compatibility.

First confirm PCSX2 sees a working controller in Settings > Controllers and that the ordinary desktop interface responds to its navigation inputs. Keep the normal desktop shortcut unchanged and prepare a copied shortcut or command for this test. If a third-party overlay intercepts controller input, close it before diagnosing the PCSX2 mode.

items: 1. Copy the normal PCSX2 launch shortcut so you can restore it easily.
2. Add `-bigpicture` to the executable arguments; optionally add `-fullscreen` before it.
3. Start PCSX2 without a game filename and wait for its library interface.
4. Use the controller to navigate the library and open one known title.
5. Pause or return to the interface using your existing verified hotkey.
6. Close PCSX2 normally, then restart once to confirm the shortcut reliably enters the same mode.

blocks.text: Pass when PCSX2 opens its Big Picture interface on launch and the mapped controller can navigate it. Then separately confirm that a chosen title boots and its in-game controls work. If only the interface opens, that demonstrates the switch works but does not diagnose game boot or title input.

items: Desktop interface still opens: confirm `-bigpicture` is in the shortcut target after the executable path.
Controller cannot navigate: return to the desktop launch and fix mapping or host input detection first.
A game does not launch: test it through the library without Big Picture to isolate boot issues.
A pause menu opens unexpectedly: check Steam Input Desktop Layout and PCSX2 hotkey collisions separately.

blocks.text: Use the original shortcut or remove `-bigpicture` from the copied one. If `-fullscreen` was also added, remove that option too. Reopen PCSX2 in the normal interface and confirm controller settings remain unchanged.
